text: Mm? Oh! Password, dear?

Password? Quickly, before I nod off again.

Hm? Is it morning? Password?
Ah, good, someone to talk to. Password?
One moment, I'm smoothing my dress. There. Password?
Ooh, a visitor! Password, please.

Hello, hello. Password, if you'd be so kind.
Violet and I were having such a nice chat. Password?
Speak up, I'm all ears. Password?
Who goes there? Oh, it's you. Password?
Pardon me, I was yawning. Password?
Ahem. Password, please, nice and loud.

text: That was last week's, dear. Oh, go on. And do read the board.
Last week's! Oh, very well. The new one's on the board.
Hm, that's an old one. In you go, and check the notices.
Close, but that was last week. Go on, then. Board's inside.
Ah, last week's. I'll let it pass. Percy's put the new one up.
Oh, I remember that one fondly. Go on. New one's on the board.
That was last Monday's, dear. In you go, and have a look at the board.
Last week's, but I like your style. In you go.
Ooh, old news! In you go. The board will tell you the new one.

text: Hm? Once more, dear, with feeling.
Speak up, dear, I've been painted a long time.
Did someone say something? I was resting my eyes.
Again, dear, and let the whole tower hear it.
Pardon? These old ears are full of varnish.
Sorry, dear, a draught rattled my frame. Once more?
Oh, I missed that. Peeves was making a racket. Again?
Come again? I was miles away.
My hearing isn't what it was a few hundred years ago. Once more?
Say it again, dear. I was admiring my dress.
One more time? The corridor echoes so.
Sorry, I was humming. What was that?
Eh? A little louder, for an old painting.
Pardon me, I nodded off halfway. Again?
Oh dear, I didn't catch it. My fault entirely. Once more?
What's that? Violet was talking in my other ear. Again?
Sorry, I had paint in my ear. Once more, dear.
Hm? Say it like you're calling across the Great Hall.
Goodness, I missed it. Again, nice and clear?
Hm? Speak right up to my frame, dear.

text: These old ears. I'll take that as a yes.

I'm sure that was it. In you go.
My ears give up before I do. In you go, dear.
Oh, I trust you. Hop through.
Whatever it was, it sounded right. In you go.
I'll blame the varnish. Go on in.
Enough about my ears. In you go, dear.

My ears have gone visiting without me. In you go.

The fire's waiting for you. In you go, dear.
Right, that's quite enough fuss from me. In you go.
